rationale: Measure true training stochasticity across full independent runs. Repeated inference from the same checkpoint is rejected.

models_to_compare.description: Concatenation of RGB and Wavelet embeddings followed by nonlinear MLP
Normalized softmax gating between RGB and Wavelet streams
Multi-key token self-attention over RGB and Wavelet tokens
Equal-weight mean probability of standalone RGB and Wavelet experts

expert_reuse_rule: Within each seed run, all fusion heads share the exact same trained RGB and Wavelet expert checkpoints.
threshold_rule: Independently development-selected threshold for each seed run via Youden's J on dev split. Test split untouched.
